question: Which demographic is most commonly affected by testicular cancer?
explanation: Testicular cancer frequently affects younger adult males, unlike prostate cancer which is more prevalent in older men. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h1)

question: Why is early detection of genitourinary neoplasms critical according to the text?

options.A: It eliminates the need for nursing care
options.B: It directly impacts patient morbidity and mortality rates
options.C: It prevents the need for any diagnostic evaluations
options.D: It exclusively affects reproductive function without touching urinary excretion

explanation: Early detection and prompt intervention directly influence and improve patient morbidity and mortality rates. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h1)

question: Which of the following is a well-established modifiable risk factor for bladder and renal cell carcinomas?
explanation: Tobacco smoking exposes the urinary tract to chemical carcinogens, making it a major modifiable risk factor for bladder and renal cancers. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h2)

question: Which parasitic infection is specifically linked to squamous cell carcinoma of the bladder in tropical regions?
explanation: Schistosomiasis causes chronic irritation and inflammation in the urinary tract, increasing the risk of squamous cell carcinoma of the bladder. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h2)

question: Which characteristic is typical of benign genitourinary tumors?
explanation: Benign tumors are localized, grow slowly, have well-defined borders, and do not metastasize or invade surrounding tissues. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h3)

question: Can a benign tumor still cause clinical complications?

options.A: No, benign tumors never cause any symptoms or problems
options.B: Yes, if its anatomical location causes urinary obstruction, like in BPH
options.C: Yes, because benign tumors frequently metastasize to the lungs
options.D: No, because they immediately transform into malignant cells

explanation: Even though they are non-cancerous, benign tumors like BPH can cause severe problems if they obstruct urinary outflow. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h3)

question: What is the most common form of kidney cancer originating in the renal cortex?
explanation: Renal cell carcinoma arises from the renal cortex and proximal renal tubules and is the most prevalent type of kidney cancer. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h4)

question: Why do testicular cancers generally have high cure rates even with metastasis?

options.A: They are completely resistant to all medications
options.B: They are highly sensitive to platinum-based chemotherapy
options.C: They never spread beyond the scrotum
options.D: They transform into benign tumors spontaneously

explanation: Testicular germ cell tumors are exceptionally responsive to platinum-based chemotherapy, leading to high cure rates. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h4)

question: What is considered the hallmark symptom for bladder and renal cancers?
explanation: Gross or microscopic hematuria (blood in the urine) is a classic and frequent hallmark sign of both bladder and renal malignancies. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h5)

question: Which serum tumor markers are specifically monitored in suspected testicular cancer?
explanation: Alpha-Fetoprotein (AFP) and Beta-Human Chorionic Gonadotropin (beta-hCG) are key tumor markers used in the diagnosis and management of testicular cancer. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h5)

question: What surgical procedure is standard for treating localized testicular cancer?
explanation: Radical orchiectomy, the surgical removal of the affected testis, is the standard initial treatment for localized testicular cancer. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h6)

question: What is the primary medical management approach for advanced or metastatic prostate cancer?
explanation: Prostate cancer is typically driven by androgens, making androgen deprivation therapy the mainstay medical treatment for advanced stages. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h6)

question: Why is maintaining strict intake and output records crucial in post-operative GU surgery care?

options.A: To calculate the patient's exact daily caloric intake
options.B: To evaluate renal perfusion and urinary diversion patency
options.C: To prevent the patient from experiencing dry mouth
options.D: To determine the exact dose of oral antibiotics needed

explanation: Tracking fluid balance is vital to ensure proper kidney function (perfusion) and check that urinary diversions or catheters are patent and draining well. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h7)

question: Which of the following is a common psychosocial concern following radical prostatectomy or cystectomy?

options.B: Erectile dysfunction and altered body image

explanation: Surgeries involving the prostate and bladder frequently impact urinary continence, sexual function (like erectile dysfunction), and body image. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h7)

question: What is the primary purpose of pelvic floor muscle training (Kegel exercises) in GU cancer rehabilitation?

options.A: To improve lower extremity strength and prevent blood clots
options.B: To rehabilitate and improve urinary continence
options.C: To stimulate appetite and prevent weight loss
options.D: To accelerate wound healing at the abdominal incision site

explanation: Pelvic floor muscle training helps strengthen the muscles supporting the bladder sphincter, aiding in the recovery of urinary continence. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h8)

question: Why are structured long-term surveillance and follow-up appointments necessary for GU cancer survivors?

options.B: To monitor for signs of cancer recurrence and ensure early detection
options.C: To reverse the effects of previous chemotherapy permanently
options.D: To adjust dietary sodium and potassium restrictions indefinitely

explanation: Surveillance schedules using imaging, cystoscopies, and tumor markers are critical for catching any cancer recurrence early. [learn more](GNS213_U4_T9#GNS213_U4_T9_h8)
